candidate.contract_code:
pub assume_specification<I>[ str::get::<I> ](
    s: &str,
    i: I,
) -> (res: Option<&<I as SliceIndex<str>>::Output>) where I: SliceIndex<str>
    ensures
        res == spec_slice_get(s, i),
;
candidate.rationale: The source delegates to SliceIndex::get, and vstd already provides the projection-aware spec_slice_get model for possibly-unsized indexed types, including str.
risks: Concrete reasoning requires specifications for the chosen SliceIndex<str> implementation.
Reference identity must not be weakened to view equality.

risks: Concrete range reasoning requires bridge axioms for the relevant SliceIndex<str> implementations.
Reference equality is intentional and must not be weakened to view equality.
